mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_snapshot (user_id, snapshot_date, category, total_amount, target_ratio, actual_ratio, balance_fund, sub_detail, total_asset_source, is_latest, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{category}, #{totalAmount}, #{targetRatio}, #{actualRatio}, #{balanceFund}, #{subDetail}, COALESCE(#{totalAssetSource}, 'top'), true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_amount = VALUES(total_amount), target_ratio = VALUES(target_ratio), actual_ratio = VALUES(actual_ratio), balance_fund = VALUES(balance_fund), sub_detail = VALUES(sub_detail), total_asset_source = VALUES(total_asset_source), is_latest = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO asset_snapshot (user_id, snapshot_date, category, total_amount, target_ratio, actual_ratio, balance_fund, sub_detail, total_asset_source, is_latest, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{category}, #{totalAmount}, #{targetRatio}, #{actualRatio}, #{balanceFund}, #{subDetail}, COALESCE(#{totalAssetSource}, 'top'), true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND snapshot_date = #{snapshotDate} AND category = #{category} AND is_latest = true )
